content_sections.heading: ANGRAU Research Associate Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ANGRAU Research Associate (Agricultural Engineering with specialization of Farm Machinery & Power Engineering (FMPE)) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Research Associate position at ANGRAU is scheduled for 08 September 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a Ph.D. in a relevant subject or a Master's degree with a 4/5 year Bachelor's degree and first division, along with at least three years of research experience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates is 45 years. Age relaxation is provided for men (40 years) and women (45 years).

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate position?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Rs. 61,000/- per month + HRA for Master's degree holders and Rs. 67,000/- per month + HRA for Ph.D. holders.

faq.question: Q6. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates, along with one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for this recruitment is a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at Acharya N.G. Ranga Agricultural University, Nandyal, Andhra Pradesh, 518502.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a contractual job?
faq.answer: Yes, this is a contractual position for the Research Associate role at ANGRAU.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the "Important Links" section on this page. It is recommended to read it thoroughly before attending the interview.
